build_repvgg_backbone: build a RepVGG backbone model with a specified architecture like B1 or D2se
create_repvgg_block: create a RepVGGBlock with configurable in_channels, out_channels, stride, and SE layer settings
switch_to_deploy_mode: switch a trained RepVGG model from training mode to deployment mode by fusing branches
reparameterize_repvgg_block: reparameterize a RepVGGBlock by fusing the 3x3 conv, 1x1 conv, and identity branch weights
build_mtsppf_block: build an MTSPPF spatial pyramid pooling block for YOLOX-PAI RepVGG backbone feature extraction
